context_for_next_testing_agent: System Error Tracking (Option B) fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/system-errors/frontend (no auth required), GET /api/system-errors (admin only, supports source filter), GET /api/system-errors/stats (admin only, returns total/last_1h/last_24h/frontend/backend/top_errors/hourly_trend), DELETE /api/system-errors/clear (admin only). Frontend auto-captures JS errors via window.onerror, unhandled promise rejections, and API 4xx/5xx errors via axios interceptor. Backend auto-captures 500 exceptions via global_exception_handler in server.py. Admin dashboard at /admin/system-health shows stats cards, trend chart, most frequent errors, and error log with detail dialog.
